title: See how you measure up
summary: Compare lifts with friends, track your body and plan your training in blocks.
changes: **Live workouts:** Minimise to the live Start button and continue the same session on desktop or phone.
**Start:** Start Up next, cardio or an empty workout, and resume a workout in progress from Home.
**Workout saves:** Finish instantly and keep logging while sessions sync quietly in the background, even offline.
**Safer edits:** Choose which version to keep when another device has changed a workout.
**Unfinished workouts:** Save, resume or discard; opt into auto-save and receive idle phone reminders.
**Workout controls:** Finish and add exercises from the header, correct live time and use larger iPhone touch targets.
**Rest bell:** When a rest ends, a ringing bell counts the extra time; tap it to jump to your next set.
**Set groups:** Log tri-sets with clearer set counts, superset borders and custom rest times.
**Add sets anywhere:** Add a set at the start or between sets, and a rest to any gap.
**Finish checks:** See ticked-set totals, catch warm-up-only exercises and get clearer save errors.
**Workout summary:** After finishing, Home shows time, sets, volume, new records and a suggested next step.
**Rep targets:** Plan rep ranges and see when to add weight.
**Relative strength:** Earn PRs as your lift-to-bodyweight ratio improves.
**Empty sets:** Ticking a set with no reps opens it to fill in, so empty sets are never logged.
**Workout plans:** Follow logged splits, save exercises by type and preview suggested weights.
**Exercises:** Rename, hide or swap lifts, with exact-name search, new icons and simpler filters.
**Merge exercises:** Relay guides custom lifts through the changes needed to combine duplicates.
**Muscle goals:** Set targets per muscle, see combined exercise gains and track neck training.
**Machine weights:** Machine-specific suggestions, per-set assignments, normalised trends and your last machine on planned days.
**Machine settings:** Edit saved defaults and inspect suggested weight-conversion ranges.
**Weekly review:** Open last week's training review from a weekly popup or Notifications.
**Training blocks:** Plan blocks in 32 colours or your own on a zoomable timeline, compare results and get suggestions in your weekly review.
**Home layout:** Add five opt-in sections and customise weekly charts, check-ins and set totals.
**Body:** Maintenance ranges, an outline that matches your profile, measurements typed straight onto the figure, clearer check-ins and easier history menus; Ankle and the FFMI calculator are gone.
**Profile:** Set your sex once in Edit profile; an administrator can change it later.
**History:** Log-style set tables, fortnight pages and single-workout exports.
**Calendar:** Planned and missed split days show as outlines; the legend lists only the workout types in view.
**Sharing:** Copy custom workout cards, view profile photos full screen, keep comment threads open and choose whether friends see your body measurements.
**Social:** Feed and Friends tabs; the feed opens with a row of friends showing who's training, then compact cards, comments and animated reactions.
**Notifications:** Newest first, quick replies and direct links to highlighted reactions or comments.
**Full backup:** Download and restore your account, with a preview before replacing data.
**Appearance:** Frosted glass, Neutral accents and dark styles, with a soft blue ray at sign-in.
**Screen layouts:** Common actions come first on Training, Body, Social and Settings.
**Tips and setup:** Tips appear when they apply and open the feature; step-by-step guides set up machines, training blocks and splits; QR invites and smarter Settings search.
**Launch prompts:** One popup per visit, and dismissed notices stay dismissed on every device.
**Phone alerts:** Rest alerts are on by default, with reminders to allow notifications.
**Offline and updates:** A small offline pill appears only after a lasting outage; updates refresh safely around unsynced work.
**Account recovery:** Tap Forgot password? to get a temporary password from your admin; an eye icon shows or hides your password.
**Cardio:** Auto MET and elevation replace MET-minutes, Distance adds Rowing and linked sessions say With workout.
silentChanges: **Fresh starts:** Add a fresh start in Settings > Training to earn PRs again after a break or injury; all-time records stay.
**Muscle goals:** Tap a muscle in Sets per muscle on Home, then Edit goal to change its weekly target.
**Calendar:** Today's outline pulses gently so it's easier to find.
**Exercises:** The ? muscle set credits button is back on each exercise.
**Updates:** Signing in applies a waiting app update straight away.
**Pop-ups and sheets:** One standard layout with a larger close button; sheets slide up, follow your finger and flick away, and pop-ups no longer close from a stray tap near their edge.
**Buttons:** One look per kind of action on every screen; actions that can't be undone use a red button named for what they do.
**Confirmations:** Brief toasts show one at a time above any pop-up, with a countdown that pauses while you touch it and Undo where it helps.
**Pages:** Every list pages the same way with numbered pages, including measurement, session and machine history.
**Navigation:** Back closes an open sheet first, tabs keep their place, and tapping the current tab jumps to its top.
**Live logger:** Planned sets start from last time's reps, records show as a small pill, notes on any exercise, iPhone fields select on tap and a forgotten workout ends at your last activity.
**Rest and sets:** Pick a rest time from + Rest, swipe from anywhere on a set to delete it, and muscle totals update after every set.
**Split days:** Start today or any planned day from the week strip or calendar; today's live workout pulses in its type's colour.
**Past workouts:** A Save button, a prompt before discarding edits, Undo after deleting, and Resume only for today's workouts.
**Counts and records:** PRs count once per set, missed-rep sets are never your top set and week headers separate workouts from cardio.
**Machine weights:** Normalise works out each machine's equivalent from any history, with a slider to adjust it and a swipeable preview.
**Exercises:** Forgiving search, full names in Up next, and merge suggestions for custom lifts that match a standard one.
**Body:** Weigh-ins open on today, measurements on the figure go into today's entry, and tap your goal to change or remove it.
**Cardio:** Zones count only once set, fill from your maximum heart rate, and sessions can be edited from Cardio history.
**Social:** Loads in the background with an outline while friends load, @usernames in search, Undo for Remove friend, fairer weekly averages and Head to head starting empty.
**Notifications:** Weekly review and What's new stay pinned until seen, new items get a dot and names open profiles.
**Settings:** Units, week start and set goals save themselves; a faster admin console and forgiving search.
**Appearance:** A new Automatic mode follows your phone's light or dark setting, plus light-mode readability fixes.
**Sign-in:** Forgot username? asks your admin; Sign out affects only this device, offline sets survive being signed out elsewhere, and display names are unique.
**Training blocks:** Blocks without a planned end say No set date.
**Workout finish and cardio scan:** Clearer errors when a set value is out of range or sync fails, and stray characters next to heart rate are ignored when scanning cardio screenshots.
**Opening Relay:** Your workouts, exercises and records appear straight away from saved copies, and every tab's data loads together.
**Splits:** Skip Up next's day with Undo, splits always follow your logged workouts, and a split day can mix workout types such as Upper body + Cardio.
**Calendar:** Today's square shows the colour of the workout planned or being logged, in arcs on a mixed day, and friends' calendars show their split.

**Live logger:** Exercises stay open after their last set with a collapse button beside Add set, a rest timer button sits in the header, cards say when you last did each exercise and planned days fill blanks from last time.
**Default rest:** New sets no longer start with 3:00; choose a Default rest in Settings or leave it at None.
**Pop-ups:** Each pop-up stays as long as it needs, from 2.5 seconds for a deleted set's Undo to 7 for errors, and closing a dialog no longer leaves a highlight ring.
**Cardio PRs:** Each cardio exercise records its longest distance, longest session and fastest times over distances that suit it, such as 5 km for running.
**Profiles:** All sessions, Workouts and Cardio tabs, reactions and comments on each workout, colours that match the calendar and a Head to head card that no longer pops in.
**Social:** Feed cards list up to three exercises with icons, +N exercises expands the remaining exercises inline, and Reply on a comment notice opens it in the feed.
**Exercises:** EZ Bar Preacher Curl is built in, and Edit on a custom exercise changes its name or equipment.
**Home:** The training block timeline marks today, and cards keep wiggling after a Customise dialog closes.
**Machine conversions:** Clearing a machine's weight and typing a new one keeps its conversion.
**Reliability:** A slow check-in save no longer stalls the server or sticks on Waiting to sync, and screens keep loading while the server saves.

**Relay app:** The server is ready for the Relay app for iPhone and Android, with secure sign-in, phone alerts, friend links that open the app, YouTube from the app, live presence and app builds in Admin.
**All-time PRs:** All-time PR badges keep their gold colour with an animated bright turquoise halo ring so they stand out from block and fresh-start records.
